en: Taho is a mixture of solid silken tofu, liquid arnibal syrup, and chewy sago pearls.
Squeezing calamansi creates an acidic liquid solution containing water, citric acid, and dissolved vitamin C.
Making bagoong isda involves a chemical change where salt breaks down fermented fish proteins over months.
Shaved ice in halo-halo undergoes a physical change from solid to liquid when mixed with warm milk.
The colorful metal bodies of old jeepneys undergo a chemical change called oxidation when exposed to rain.
The extremely hard shell of a Bicol pili nut is a physical property protecting the soft seed inside.
Boholano artisans make asin tibuok by filtering seawater and evaporating the liquid to leave solid cone-shaped salt.
Adding crushed tabon-tabon fruit to raw fish in kinilaw causes a chemical change that denatures the proteins.
Erupting Mayon Volcano releases molten lava, which is liquid rock that cools into solid volcanic rock.
Sinigang broth is an aqueous solution where water acts as the solvent dissolving tamarind and salt solutes.
Frying pork for chicharon causes a physical change as the liquid water inside rapidly boils into gas.
Ube halaya is a thick mixture created by heating mashed purple yam, milk, and butter until water evaporates.
